mule.xsi:schemaLocation: http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/core http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/core/current/mule.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/ee/core http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/ee/core/current/mule-ee.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/http http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/http/current/mule-http.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/mule-apikit http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/mule-apikit/current/mule-apikit.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/os http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/os/current/mule-os.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/db http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/db/current/mule-db.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/email http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/email/current/mule-email.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/vm http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/vm/current/mule-vm.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/secure-properties http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/secure-properties/current/mule-secure-properties.xsd http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/api-gateway http://www.mulesoft.org/schema/mule/api-gateway/current/mule-api-gateway.xsd

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import modules::ErrorResponse output application/json --- ErrorResponse::build("INVALID_PAYMENT_EVENT", "Payment event failed validation. See 'fields' for offending paths.", correlationId, ErrorResponse::fieldPaths(error.description))
%dw 2.0 import modules::ErrorResponse output application/json --- ErrorResponse::build(error.errorType.identifier, "Request could not be processed.", correlationId)
%dw 2.0 import modules::ErrorResponse output application/json --- ErrorResponse::build("DUPLICATE_EVENT", "This eventId was already accepted. No further processing performed.", correlationId)

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- 'DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE eventId=' ++ (vars.eventId default 'n/a') ++ ' type=' ++ error.errorType.identifier ++ ' corrId=' ++ correlationId]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import modules::ErrorResponse output application/json --- ErrorResponse::build("SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE", "Event could not be queued. It was NOT accepted; please retry.", correlationId)

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- 'UNEXPECTED_ERROR type=' ++ error.errorType.namespace ++ ':' ++ error.errorType.identifier ++ ' eventId=' ++ (vars.eventId default 'n/a') ++ ' corrId=' ++ correlationId]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import modules::ErrorResponse output application/json --- ErrorResponse::build("INTERNAL_ERROR", "An unexpected error occurred. Quote the correlationId to support.", correlationId)

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { amountLimit: p('risk.amountLimit') as Number, velocityMax: p('risk.velocityMax') as Number, highRiskCategories: (p('risk.highRiskCategories') splitBy ",") map upper(trim($)), usualHourStart: p('risk.usualHourStart') as Number, usualHourEnd: p('risk.usualHourEnd') as Number, wAmount: p('risk.weight.amount') as Number, wGeo: p('risk.weight.geo') as Number, wVelocity: p('risk.weight.velocity') as Number, wMerchant: p('risk.weight.merchant') as Number, wHour: p('risk.weight.hour') as Number, wWatchlist: p('risk.weight.watchlist') as Number, mediumMin: p('risk.band.mediumMin') as Number, highMin: p('risk.band.highMin') as Number, blockMin: p('risk.band.blockMin') as Number, failSafeScore: p('risk.failSafeScore') as Number }
